tagline: Manage Restream multistreaming: read your profile, list streaming destinations (channels), toggle destinations or edit channel metadata, and retrieve your stream key. Use when the user wants to control where a livestream goes without opening the Restream dashboard.
auth: provider OAuth 2.0 via the secure credential flow

actions.name: stream-key
actions.description: show your stream key (output is a live secret)

name: runway
title: Runway
tagline: Runway developer API: text-to-video, image-to-video, task polling, video upscale, lip-sync.
auth: API secret via the secure credential flow

name: sendgrid
title: Sendgrid
tagline: Send email, check stats and profile.
auth: API key (per-user)

actions.name: stats
actions.description: email stats for the last 7 days

name: sentry
title: Sentry
tagline: List organizations and projects, triage unresolved issues from the last 24h, and resolve/archive/assign issues.
auth: auth token (per-user, sentry.io \u2192 Settings \u2192 Auth Tokens)

name: shippo
title: Shippo
tagline: Ship through many carriers (USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL and others) with one API: get rates for a shipment; buy a printable postage label; track a parcel; refund unused labels. Reach for this when the user needs to price or purchase shipping for a package.
auth: API token via the secure credential flow

actions.name: rates
actions.description: rates for a shipment (no label bought)

actions.name: buy
actions.description: buy a label from a rate

name: shopify
title: Shopify
tagline: View orders, products, customers; create products and discounts with confirmation. No order or customer writes, ever.
auth: Shopify Admin API access token (per-user, Shopify admin \u2192 Apps \u2192 Develop apps \u2192 custom app; scopes read_orders/read_products/read_customers plus write_products/write_discounts for writes)

name: slack
title: Slack
tagline: Read channels, post messages, list users. The most-requested workplace connector.
auth: Slack OAuth (per-user)

actions.name: search
actions.description: search messages (needs search:read on the token)

name: smartcar
title: Smartcar
tagline: Read and control connected cars across many brands (Tesla, Ford, GM, Toyota, BMW, Hyundai and others) through one standardized API. Read odometer, location, charge and battery level, fuel level and tire pressure; lock/unlock doors; start/stop charging; set charge limits and schedules; route the built-in navigation. Use when the user mentions their car and the brand has no dedicated connector here, or asks for cross-brand vehicle telemetry and control.
auth: provider OAuth 2.0 (Smartcar Connect) via the secure credential flow

actions.name: telemetry
actions.description: odometer, location, charge, battery, fuel, tires

name: smartthings
title: Smartthings
tagline: Read device status and issue capability commands across a Samsung SmartThings account: locations, devices, switches, dimmers, locks, thermostats, sirens, garage door controllers, and window shades. Use it when the user asks about or wants to change the state of anything paired to their SmartThings hub or cloud account. This connector drives real physical hardware, so every write is confirmation-gated (see Operating Rules).
auth: provider OAuth 2.0 via the secure credential flow

actions.name: auth
actions.description: status check: verify token, list locations

name: spotify
title: Spotify
tagline: Read your profile, playlists, top tracks and artists, and search the catalog. Playlist and library writes need your confirmation.
auth: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code (per-user)

name: square
title: Square
tagline: Work with a Square seller account: list locations and payments, create orders, push a checkout to a physical Square Terminal for in-person payment, charge a payment source directly, cancel a pending Terminal checkout, and refund a payment. Reach for this when the user needs to take or return money through Square.
auth: provider OAuth 2.0 or personal access token via the secure credential flow

name: stripe
title: Stripe
tagline: Read-only Stripe visibility: balance, recent charges, customers. No write commands ship: expanding to writes is a deliberate v2.
auth: Stripe restricted API key (per-user, Dashboard \u2192 Developers \u2192 API keys; read-only permissions suffice)

name: supabase
title: Supabase
tagline: List tables, query rows, and insert/update/delete rows in your Supabase Postgres database.
auth: service_role key (per-user, project Settings \u2192 API)

name: supermemory
title: Supermemory
tagline: Store and recall with Supermemory: add memories and documents, hybrid search, upload files, tune settings.
auth: API key via the secure credential flow

name: switchbot
title: Switchbot
tagline: Read status and send commands to SwitchBot devices over the official OpenAPI v1.1: SwitchBot Bot (physical button presser), SwitchBot Lock, Curtain and Blind Tilt motors, plugs, lights, air conditioners, infrared remotes, and saved scenes. Use it when the user asks about or wants to change anything in their SwitchBot setup. Commands drive real physical hardware, so writes are confirmation-gated (see Operating Rules).
auth: token + secret pair via the secure credential flow

actions.name: auth
actions.description: status check: verify token, count devices

name: tally
title: Tally
tagline: List forms, read submissions, manage form blocks.
auth: API key (per-user; free on all plans)

actions.name: form
actions.description: fetch a form with its blocks

name: tavily
title: Tavily
tagline: Fast, clean web research: one call returns an AI answer plus ranked sources with snippets. Read-only.
auth: Tavily API key (per-user, tavily.com)

name: telegram
title: Telegram
tagline: Send messages and read updates through your own Telegram bot. Bots can't message users who haven't started them first.
auth: Telegram bot token from @BotFather (per-user, single token)

name: tesla-fleet-api
title: Tesla Fleet Api
tagline: Control Tesla vehicles through the official Tesla Fleet API: read live vehicle state, wake a sleeping car, and send signed commands (lock/unlock, keyless drive, charge control, preconditioning, honk/flash, trunk, sentry/valet, speed limit, navigation). Use when the user mentions their Tesla car or asks for vehicle actuation.
auth: provider OAuth 2.0 via the secure credential flow

name: tesla-powerwall
title: Tesla Powerwall
tagline: Monitor and control Tesla energy sites (Powerwall, solar) through the official Tesla Fleet API. Read live power flows, battery state, and site settings; change backup reserve percentage, operation mode, and Storm Watch. Use when the user mentions their Powerwall, Tesla energy site, backup reserve, or storm mode.
auth: provider OAuth 2.0 via the secure credential flow

actions.name: status
actions.description: live power: solar, battery, grid, load

name: ticktick
title: Ticktick
tagline: Read and write TickTick: list projects and tasks, create tasks, complete and delete tasks.
auth: OAuth 2.0 via the secure credential flow

name: tiktok
title: Tiktok
tagline: Read your TikTok profile and video list. API access needs TikTok app approval first, and posting is not shipped.
auth: OAuth 2.0 (per-user; TikTok app approval required)

actions.name: videos
actions.description: list the user's videos with stats

name: todoist
title: Todoist
tagline: List tasks, create tasks, and mark them done in Todoist.
auth: Todoist API token (per-user, Settings \u2192 Integrations \u2192 Developer)

actions.name: tasks
actions.description: list tasks (content, due date, priority, project)

name: transistor
title: Transistor
tagline: Manage podcast hosting on Transistor.fm: list shows and episodes, create draft episodes, update or delete them, and upload episode audio via Transistor's two-step upload flow. Use when the user wants to publish or manage podcast episodes programmatically.
auth: API key via the secure credential flow

actions.name: authorize-upload
actions.description: step 1 of audio upload (prints raw JSON)

name: triggerdev
title: Triggerdev
tagline: Trigger background jobs, list runs, manage schedules.
auth: API key (per-environment)

actions.name: run
actions.description: show one run's status and output

name: tuya
title: Tuya
tagline: Read status and send control commands to Tuya Cloud / Smart Life devices: smart plugs and switches, lights, thermostats, curtain motors, and supported smart locks, plus executing saved scenes. Use it when the user asks about or wants to change anything paired through the Tuya or Smart Life app. Commands drive real physical hardware, so writes are confirmation-gated (see Operating Rules).
auth: Access ID + Access Secret pair via the secure credential flow

actions.name: auth
actions.description: status check: fetch a cloud token

name: twitch
title: Twitch
tagline: Read and write Twitch via the Helix API: channel profile, follower stats, live stream status, past videos, channel title and game updates, clip creation.
auth: provider OAuth via the secure credential flow

actions.name: stream
actions.description: live now? viewer count, title, game

name: typeform
title: Typeform
tagline: List forms and responses, create forms, and manage response webhooks with confirmation.
auth: personal access token (per-user)

name: uber-direct
title: Uber Direct
tagline: Dispatch same-day couriers through Uber Direct for food, retail, grocery, or parcel deliveries. Get a price and time quote without dispatching anyone, create a delivery when the user approves, check its status, and cancel a pending one. Reach for this when the user needs something picked up and dropped off locally today.
auth: provider OAuth 2.0 client-credentials via the secure credential flow

name: unifi-protect
title: Unifi Protect
tagline: Read camera state and still snapshots from a local UniFi Protect console (Protect 5.3+) through the official Integration API, and adjust camera settings: PTZ position, flood lights, chimes, talkback. Use it when the user asks what their UniFi cameras see, wants a snapshot saved, or wants to change camera behavior. Everything runs against the local console; there is no cloud dependency.
auth: integration key via the secure credential flow

name: unsplash
title: Unsplash
tagline: Search Unsplash's free stock photo library, browse the latest photos, look up a photo's details, browse a photographer's portfolio or a topic, and download an image while honoring Unsplash's API guidelines. At the Client-ID tier this connector is read-only.
auth: access key via the secure credential flow

name: upstash
title: Upstash
tagline: Run Redis commands over REST.
auth: Per-database token (host declared at connect time)

name: vapi
title: Vapi
tagline: Manage voice AI assistants, phone numbers, and calls. Outbound calls need exact-match confirmation; test numbers by default.
auth: API key (per-user)

name: veed
title: Veed
tagline: Remove backgrounds from video with VEED's direct developer API (POST /v1/video/background-remove): standard quality, fast throughput and green-screen chroma-key with spill suppression. Outputs are VP9-with-alpha or H.264 RGB+alpha, up to 4K.
auth: API key via the secure credential flow

name: vercel
title: Vercel
tagline: See your Vercel account, projects, and recent deployments.
auth: personal token (per-user, vercel.com/account/tokens)

name: webflow
title: Webflow
tagline: Work with the Webflow Data API v2: list sites, inspect site details, browse CMS collections and items, create/update/delete CMS items, and publish a site. Uses a per-site token from Site Settings.

actions.name: collections
actions.description: list CMS collections on a site

actions.name: items
actions.description: list CMS items in a collection

name: wise
title: Wise
tagline: View Wise profiles and multi-currency balances. Read-only by design.
auth: Wise personal API token (per-user, wise.com \u2192 Settings \u2192 API tokens)

auth: OAuth2 PKCE (per-user; paid read access)

auth: API key (per-user)

name: ynab
title: Ynab

auth: OAuth 2.0 via the secure credential flow

name: youtube
title: Youtube

auth: OAuth 2.0 (per-user)

auth: API key via the secure credential flow
